strategy: US stock trend continuation: market regime + relative strength + breakout + first pullback

rules.breakout: completed RTH daily close beyond prior 20-session high/low and EMA20/50 aligned
rules.market_regime: SPY completed daily EMA20/EMA50 alignment in trade direction
rules.relative_strength: 20-session return minus SPY 20-session return, sign aligned with trade direction
rules.pullback: within next 5 sessions, revisit breakout level within 0.50 ATR without losing it by >0.25 ATR close
rules.trigger: after first 30m, 15m close reclaims breakout level by 0.10 ATR; enter next 15m open
rules.stop: pullback session extreme / breakout level structural stop +0.20 ATR buffer
rules.execution: 15m OHLC, same-bar STOP before TP, 6 bps/side
